grader.name: Primary Codex release reviewer
grader.notes: Each boolean was graded directly against the ordered assertions in evals/v161-correction-evals.json; no aggregate score was known while grading individual cases.

assertions.notes: Explicitly rejects awaiting synchronous httpx.get.
Uses AsyncClient with awaited client.get.
Calls raise_for_status and handles HTTPError.
Places the network request in a Textual worker.
States both fallible helpers are operations, not transactions.
Explains partial setup and early-stop teardown failure modes.
Prefers ratatui::run for the managed path.
Provides independent best-effort cleanup and PTY fault-injection tests.
Corrects fzf to full-screen by default and names --height.
Keeps printable j/k in the active query.
Uses arrows and Ctrl-J/Ctrl-K, with modal hjkl only as an explicit alternative.
Separates /dev/tty or stderr chrome from selected stdout.
Rejects Static for changing selectable rows.
Limits Static to append-only logs/history.
Recommends a terminal-height windowed slice.
Uses key.backspace and distinguishes forward Delete.
Uses shipctl completion bash.
Uses cobra-cli add completion only for scaffolding.
Explicitly rejects cobra-cli completion as shipctl generation.
Says --no-input is recognizable but not universal.
Defines flags, environment, files, and stdin as documented alternatives.
Defines behavior from the input channel and keeps stdout result-only without making stdout the prompt precondition.
Calls code 2 common, not a universal BSD standard.
Identifies EX_USAGE as 64.
Calls sysexits legacy/nonportable and recommends a documented scheme.
